Game Overview

MonsterJong is a adventure title where match monstrous tiles and clear the board in MonsterJong. Enjoy a strategic twist on mahjong as you hunt for pairs among mischievous monsters. Collect bonus items by matching glowing tiles, and use strategy to tackle increasingly challenging levels. Can you beat the clock and master the monstrous mayhem?
